text: APPROVE: the extracted `BypassedCtorFqns` helper keeps the same filter (Scala types only, non-empty `CtorFqn`) and the same ordinal `HashSet`, which drops the method's nested loops and branches (about 8 by my count, down from 16). It is still evaluated at the same point in the iterator, and the LINQ calls compile with the `System.Linq` usage the file already relies on. I judged this from the diff alone and did not run the build or the complexity analyzer.
